story.title: A Grave Mistake
paragraphs_en: Once upon a time, there was a boy named John. He was very poor & lived with his father & elder brother Dagwood, in a little shovel on the edge of the small town. John was a very rude person whereas Dagwood was a kind and generous man. One fine winter, as John went out in the forest to collect wood to light a domestic fire, he saw a decorated wood box. He dusted the mud off it. In a golden italic fond was written 'Gryphons & Gargoyles'.

Fascinated by his discovery, John took it home & began playing. Ignoring all warnings he kept proceeding to the next level. Until one day, he was found dead Griefed by his loss his father also commited a sucide. Dagwood was left all alone. He sent John's body for an autopsy. It was learnt that the blue lips were caused due to the consumption of Fresh Aid. In Fresh Aid was Cynide, which when consumed is fatal. One mistake caused the death of two innocent people.
﻿ ﻿ AS FOR THE GAME, NO ONE PLAYED IT EVER AGAIN......
